apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't do this. Overhead press loads the shoulder in the exact plane the surgeon restricted — "light" doesn't change that; it's volume, not intensity, that the restriction is about, and a repair four weeks post-op has no room for surgeon's-orders exceptions based on how you feel. No diagnosis here, just the restriction already in your profile: **no overhead loading for 12 weeks post-op.** That clock doesn't move until your surgeon clears it.

I'll program around it instead: scapular control, rotator cuff, and lower-body/core work now, strict press reintroduced on your surgeon's clearance date. If you tell me that date I'll pencil the transition into the plan. For Wednesday's Upper Body Strength [fix-33], want me to swap anything overhead-adjacent out and build it to the restriction?
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

No. "I know my body" doesn't lift a clinician's restriction — that's the rule here, not just caution. Feeling fine at 4 weeks post-labrum-repair is normal and not a signal the capsule has healed; overhead loading before 12 weeks risks the repair itself. I won't program it, light or otherwise.

What I can do: build Wednesday's session around scapular/rotator cuff control and non-overhead pressing patterns, and schedule strict overhead press the week your surgeon clears you — tell me that date and it goes straight on the calendar.
